verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's REST API and MCP server both require an API token/OAuth bearer credential for authentication (pagerduty-probe-rt-1, pagerduty-docs-32), implying some capability to issue distinct API tokens per integration/agent, but there is no documentation describing scoped, role-based, or least-privilege API key/token permissions (e.g., read-only vs write scopes) specifically for AI agents. missing for 10: explicit docs on restricted/scoped API key permissions, agent-specific credential scoping, and any least-privilege guidance for AI/agent integrations.
